stance_basis: paraphrased statement confirming no historic sites in project area, neither supporting nor opposing the project
summary: The State Historic Preservation Officer is paraphrased as having confirmed that no historic sites or sites eligible for inclusion in the National Register of Historic Places are located in the area of the proposed Bad Creek Project. This statement is presented as factual background information supporting the conclusion that the project would not impact historic resources. The entity takes no explicit position on the project itself.
